empty.title: You don't have any rewards yet
empty.description: Once you create your first reward, explorers will be able to redeem it with their GeoPoints.

createForm.title: Create reward

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: Spell out exactly what the explorer gets and under what conditions.
description.hint: This is what explorers read before redeeming. Put any restrictions here.

geoPointsCost.label: GeoPoints cost
geoPointsCost.hint: What the explorer pays with the points they earned checking in.

estimatedValueCop.label: Estimated value (COP)
estimatedValueCop.hint: What you'd normally charge for this. Explorers don't see it.

place.label: Place (optional)
place.hint: Leave it empty and it works at any of your places.

stockTotal.label: Stock (optional)
stockTotal.hint: How many redemptions are available. Empty = unlimited.

validation.geoPointsPositive: The cost must be greater than zero
validation.stockPositive: Stock must be greater than zero, or empty for unlimited

createForm.draftNote: It saves as a draft. You'll be able to publish it once you add an image.

unavailable.title: Fields that aren't available yet
unavailable.description: Reward type, the General/Special classification, validity dates and your own terms can't be configured yet: the backend doesn't have those fields. They're requested and will follow.

errors.business: We couldn't identify your business, so we can't create the reward.

errors.notFound: This reward doesn't exist, or it isn't your business's.
errors.business: We couldn't identify your business, so we couldn't load the reward either.

stock.outOfStock: Out of stock: no redemptions left

image.empty: This reward doesn't have an image yet.
image.emptyHint: The image is uploaded after the reward is created, same as place photos.

editForm.title: Edit reward
editForm.notEditableByStatus: This reward is {{status}}, and in that state the server won't accept changes.
editForm.notEditableHint: Only a published, paused or out-of-stock reward can be edited.

place.unlinkWarning: Careful: leaving this empty UNLINKS the reward from the place and makes it valid at all of them. Saving replaces every field, not just the ones you changed.

stockTotal.hintCommitted: There are already {{committed, number}} committed units. You can't lower the stock below that number.
stockTotal.hintUncapped: It has no cap today. If you set one, it has to cover the redemptions already committed.

errors.business: We couldn't identify your business, so we can't save the changes.
errors.stockBelowCommitted: You can't lower the stock below {{committed, number}}: those units are already committed by redemptions.
errors.stockBelowCommittedUnknown: The stock you entered is lower than the units already committed by redemptions. Try a higher number.
errors.concurrency: Someone else saved changes to this reward while you were editing. Reload to see where it landed and reapply yours: saving as-is would overwrite that change.
errors.notEditable: This reward's status changed and it no longer accepts edits. Reload the reward to see where it landed.
errors.businessNotActive: Your business isn't active, so you can't edit rewards. The reward is fine: it's the business status that's blocking.

pause.success: Reward paused: explorers no longer see it
pause.exhaustedHint: Pausing an out-of-stock reward stops offering it. It doesn't restock: for that you need to edit it.

republish.success: Reward republished: explorers can redeem it now
republish.successButExhausted: It was republished, but it ended up OUT OF STOCK because there's none available. Explorers can see it and can't redeem it. Edit the stock to offer it again.
republish.willExhaust: Careful: this reward has no stock available, so republishing it will leave it OUT OF STOCK instead of published. If you want to offer it again, edit the stock first.
republish.pausedStaysHint: Restocking doesn't unpause it on its own: while it's paused it stays paused until you republish it.

errors.generic: We couldn't change the reward's status.
errors.alreadyPaused: This reward was already paused. Reload to see its current status.
errors.notPaused: Only a paused reward can be republished, and this one isn't anymore. Reload to see its current status.
errors.invalidTransition: This reward's status doesn't allow this action. Reload to see where it landed.
errors.businessNotActive: Your business isn't active, so you can't change your rewards' status. The reward is fine: it's the business status that's blocking.

image.emptyHint: Upload it now: it's the first thing an explorer sees when the reward is offered to them.

errors.tooLarge: The image is over {{maxSizeMb, number}} MB. Try a lighter one.
errors.unsupportedFormat: That format isn't accepted. It has to be JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.empty: The file arrived empty. Pick it again.
errors.noFile: No file arrived. Pick the image again.
errors.notFound: This reward doesn't exist, or it isn't your business's.
errors.businessNotActive: Your business isn't active, so you can't upload images. The reward is fine: it's the business status that's blocking.
errors.serverOrConflict: We couldn't upload the image. It may have been a momentary glitch, or someone else may have been editing the reward at the same time: try again.
